title: Real-time Studies of Nucleation and Growth of GaN Nanostructures on SiNx
content: Semiconductor polytype heterostructures, which are chemically homogeneous structures exhibiting an abrupt transition in crystal structure, present opportunities for enhanced performance exceeding those of composition-based semiconductor heterostructures. Of particular interest are heterostructures formed through an abrupt change in atomic plane stacking sequence, such as the transition from the wurtzite (WZ) to the zincblende (ZB) polytype. Notably, the formation of ZB segments within WZ nanowires (NWs) has been proposed to function as quantum dots (QDs), which are promising candidates for single-photon emitters [1].
